data.narrative:
GalaxEye is a Series A stage space & aerospace company founded by Suyash Singh and Kishan Thakkar that has raised $10M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a broad sector universe of 5 public comps (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs, though most lack direct comparability at the Series A stage.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable approach. Using total capital raised ($10M) as a baseline proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement yields an implied valuation of $20M. This reflects the expected value accretion between early and later Series A financing rounds. Peer-median analysis was not applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comps meeting the three-datapoint minimum threshold within the narrow Space & Aerospace Series A cohort. Public-comp anchoring via the sector's 26.4x P/S median cannot be deployed without target revenue disclosure, which is unavailable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $17M to $23M, with a median point of $20M. This range assumes modest variance around the single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue guidance (precluding relative valuation), the nascent nature of most direct private comparables, and limited visibility into GalaxEye's unit economics or technology differentiation relative to the crowded frontier-space sector.
